Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a multicystic lesion in the fetal right lung (indicated by arrows) with visible systemic arterial supply on Doppler, characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or CPAM. Such lower/middle lobe lesions typically present as a mass effect that displaces the heart to the contralateral (left) side and can elevate the ipsilateral hemidiaphragm due to space occupation.
